meta.title: Document Push to SAP DMS: refused for a user without the MDM / Master Data Team role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the MDM / Master Data Team role on the specified Enterprise tenant.
Locate and use Document Push to SAP DMS to verify that the unprivileged user is refused or the action is absent.
Repeat the action as an MDM / Master Data Team user and verify that it is available.
Determine whether tenant RBAC grants the action to additional roles.
